caption: The drawing features a vessel resembling a teapot or a kettle, composed of two main sections: the upper portion is dome-shaped and colored gold with a visible wick protruding from its top, while the lower portion is a truncated cone and shaded in dark gray or black. The vessel has a curved handle attached to the right side and a short, cylindrical spout that projects outward and upward from the upper section. Beneath the colored drawing, there is a smaller, simplified outline sketch of the same vessel, with matching proportions, spout, handle, and wick, but without color or shading. The background is a plain, off-white or beige parchment. The artist's signature and date are visible below the outline sketch.
title: Petticoat Lamp
